pairs.evidence: app/control/controlRoomConfirm.ts:73 The version fingerprint of the Art. 22 gate is computed and compared only inside this client reducer; the executed approve (app/control/ControlRoom.tsx:149 POSTs /api/devcase/lifecycle/${id}/approve with no body) carries only the id, so the server checks stage but never that the approved case is the one the operator saw.

techniques.evidence: app/control/controlRoomConfirm.ts:72 Approval is bound to the shown descriptor only in the decider (UI); the applier/door never receives or checks the fingerprint, so a case regenerated under the same lifecycle id between confirm and write is approved unseen.

app/control/controlRoomConfirm.ts:62 The floor value is part of the armed key and the same value is sent, so what runs on confirm is the number the operator saw; a moved suggestion re-arms instead of firing.

app/features/hiring/decisions/useDecisionsQueue.ts:308 Queue derives from the pending set in the system of record and the header count is pending.length from the same predicate; calendar-gate kinds are deliberately routed to the Schedule tab.

techniques.evidence: app/api/jobseeker/sources/[id]/route.ts:55 The request does not echo the fingerprint the owner was shown; the record binds to the server's current hash rather than to what was shown (narrow window: catalog terms change per deploy).
